name: surf-vita
description: PS Vita client for the Surf remote browser: Chromium on your computer, streamed to the Vita
long_description: A PS Vita client for Surf: Chromium runs on a computer and streams to the Vita as H.264, with touch, buttons, text input, tabs and audio. Personal project, tested on a Vita 1000 (Ensō, HENkaku). Clone with `--recursive` (Surf v0.17.0 is the `upstream` submodule).
